name: POS Product Quantity Limit
description: Odoo Point of Sale product sales limits prevent overselling and manage product scarcity by letting you set maximum purchase quantities per customer, directly within your POS system.
summary: The Limit Product Sales in POS module for Odoo helps businesses prevent overselling and manage product scarcity by setting maximum purchase quantities per customer. With product-wise or category-wise limits, you can restrict how many units can be sold in each transaction. If the limit is exceeded, the POS system automatically blocks the order and displays a warning message. This ensures fair distribution, better inventory control, and compliance with sales policies directly within your POS system. This module is especially useful for managing scarce items, promotional products, and regulated goods where strict purchase limits are required. Whenever a cashier tries to sell more than the configured limit, the system automatically validates the order and prevents it from being confirmed, displaying a clear warning message on the POS screen. By applying these restrictions, businesses can maintain better inventory management, ensure fair distribution of high-demand items, and avoid compliance issues related to overselling. With this feature, you can easily define maximum sales quantities per product or product category, ensuring that no customer can purchase more than the allowed amount during a transaction.
